_comment: Rotation list for the proactive podcast researcher (scripts/podcast_researcher.py) and the podcast-deep-research workflow (.claude/workflows/podcast-deep-research.js). Each entry is one candidate episode topic. 'domain' defaults to 'medicine'; only medicine topics (with 'pubmed_query' feeding PubMed E-utilities) are eligible for the local PubMed fallback — non-medicine domains ('query' instead) are researched exclusively by the deep-research workflow with domain-appropriate lenses. 'debate' picks --format debate over deep-dive when the topic has genuine, citable controversy.
